Chi Samui is a beach club, bar and restaurant on Bang Rak (Big Buddha Beach) on Samui's north coast, about 5 minutes from the airport and an 8-minute walk from the Big Buddha pier. It is open daily from about 11:00 to midnight. Its 25 m saltwater infinity pool with a swim-up bar is the reason to come, because the sea here is shallow and murky, and there is a separate kids' pool. Expect DJs and chilled house by day, the sky turning pink over Koh Phangan at sunset, and a calmer, more mixed crowd than at the Chaweng party clubs.

Map of Chi Samui

Chi is on the western half of Bang Rak bay, on the sand below the beach road. The Big Buddha pier, for the Haad Rin Queen ferry to Koh Phangan, is about an 8-minute walk away. Big Buddha itself (9.5708, 100.0598) is at the eastern end of the bay.

What it's like

Chi opened on Bang Rak in 2018. It belongs to Kalara, a local property company whose beachfront apartment buildings line this stretch of the bay. The layout is simple: sunbeds and sofa beds around the long infinity pool, the swim-up bar in the pool, a beach bar and restaurant behind, and tables on the sand at the water's edge. The kids' pool sits by the beach, apart from the main pool.

The mood is relaxed rather than rowdy. By day it is couples, families, villa guests and people killing time before a flight or a ferry. Late afternoon is when it fills up, the DJ turns the volume up and the bay turns gold. Visitors warn that the music can be fairly loud in the late afternoon, so if you want silence, come at lunchtime. After dark it becomes a restaurant with a bar and music.

Two things to know about Bang Rak. First, the sea here is shallow and often murky, and it is not a swimming beach; the pool is the swim. Second, the bay lies under the approach to Samui Airport, so planes pass low overhead through the day. Some people find it fun; light sleepers in nearby villas don't.

A sister hotel, Chi Samui Resort, gives its guests a free shuttle to the beach club (hourly, 10:00–19:00, according to one 2026 source) and discounts on food and drinks.

Food and drinks

The kitchen serves modern international food with Thai specials, grills, seafood and pizzas, plus breakfast plates in the morning and a long wine list and signature cocktails at the bar. Dishes visitors mention include lamb leg, octopus and the mimosas. Prices sit at the upper end for Bang Rak, above the seafood restaurants on the sand nearby.

Chi doesn't publish a price list online, and we haven't been able to confirm current prices, so we don't quote them. As a general guide, a beer at a Samui beach club cost about 100–200 THB and a cocktail about 250–450 THB in 2026; check the menu before you order. If the bill shows "++", add 10 % service and 7 % VAT.

For cheaper food, the Bang Rak seafood restaurants on the beach road price fish by weight (check whether the board means per kilo or per 100 g), and Plaza The Green Market near the Seatran pier runs daily from about 15:00 to 22:00. See Bang Rak (Big Buddha Beach).

Tips

  • Arrive close to 11:00 for the best daybeds; they fill early, especially at weekends and from December to April.
  • Book ahead for a sofa bed or a group, and ask whether there is a minimum spend before you settle in.
  • Bring mosquito repellent for the hour after sunset.
  • November and early December are the wettest months, and a squall can empty the pool deck in minutes. Check the forecast.
  • Catching the 17:00 Haad Rin Queen ferry from the Big Buddha pier? Chi is an 8-minute walk away. Allow time and don't cut it fine.
  • Don't swim in the sea after drinking, and don't ride a scooter home.

Who it suits, and who should go elsewhere

Go if you want a pool day with music and a sunset view, you are a couple, you have young children who will use the kids' pool, you are staying in Bang Rak, Plai Laem or Bophut, or you have a few hours to fill near the airport.

Go elsewhere if you want a big party with international DJs (go to SEEN Beach Club in Chaweng or ARKbar), if you want to swim in clear sea (go to Choeng Mon, 10 minutes east), or if you want the sun dropping into the sea (that is the west coast; see Koh Samui sunset spots). Tembo, Malika and 79 Beach Club are the other Bang Rak clubs, compared in Koh Samui beach clubs.

Getting there

Chi is just off Route 4171, the road that leaves the ring road by the airport and loops round the north-east tip. Grab works well here and there is parking on site. Grab drivers can't collect from the airport pickup zone, so from a flight it is easier to pre-book.
